name: Cairo, Sharm El Sheikh and Jordan Tour
description: Explore the natural beauty, fascinating culture of Egypt and Jordan through this remarkable Cairo, Sharm El Sheikh and Jordan Tour. Scout around gleaming Egypt and Jordan and touch the gleaming parts of ancient Pharaonic at Hatshepsut Temple, stare at Karnak Temple pillars, then head out towards Petra the rose city and more with Ibis Egypt Tours.
overview: Explore the natural beauty, fascinating culture of Egypt and Jordan through this remarkable Cairo, Sharm El Sheikh and Jordan Tour. Scout around gleaming Egypt and Jordan and touch the gleaming parts of ancient Pharaonic at Hatshepsut Temple, stare at Karnak Temple pillars, then head out towards Petra the rose city and more with Ibis Egypt Tours.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at cairo Airport, your dreams will come true, Ibis Egypt tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will escort you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel, enjoy your sightseeing tours to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra synagogue, at the end of your tour transfer to Giza train station for departure to Aswan by night Sleeper train, and have dinner. Overnight on Sleeper Train

itinerary.title: Aswan Day Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from Aswan train station, then he will escort you to embrace the culture of Aswan by visiting the High Dam which was constructed at 1960, it was built to provide Egypt with electricity and irrigation, moreover to protect Egypt from the Nile River flood, then head towards the Unfinished Obelisk, amuse your eyes while visiting Philae Temple, Belongs to Isis and Hathor goddesses, Philae Temple was flooded every year from Dec. till approx. Mar. before the High Dam, as the water level was increasing every year, and clients want to visit Philae Temple before were using boats to be able to visit, at the end of your tour Ibis Egypt tours will escort you to your hotel in Aswan, check in. Overnight in Aswan

itinerary.title: Abu Simbel Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast box is waiting for you at your hotel, then early in the morning Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel in Aswan, he will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle towards the magnificent Temple of Abu Simbel, it is one of the best sights you have ever seen, Walk through Temple of Ramses II, and the Temple of Nefertari, both temples were endanger by submersion in Lake Nasser because of the construction of the High Dam, but the Egyptian government agreed the rescue operation of the UNESCO for Abu Simbel Temple, Finally once your tour concluded Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you back to your hotel in Aswan. Overnight in Aswan

itinerary.title: Karnak and Luxor Temple Tour
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast is waiting for you at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel, he will escort you to Luxor by air-conditioned vehicle, once you arrive Luxor start to embrace Luxor culture by visiting Karnak Temple with its inconceivable pillars, It is considering the largest temple in Egypt, it consists of 6 Temples, The temples of Karnak including ten edifices, six of which are on the east-west axis, and four on the north-south axis, then move towards Luxor Temple which was established by Amenhotep III, but Ramses II added the front part and completed the Temple, Luxor Temple located in the middle of Luxor city and was connected to Karnak Temple by avenue of sphinxes at ancient time, at the end of your tour Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to your hotel in Luxor. Overnight in Luxor

itinerary.title: West Bank of Luxor Tour
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast is waiting for you at your hotel, Unleash your inner by visiting Valley of the Kings (Visit 03 tombs only ), head out towards Hatshepsut temple, with its particular decoration and design, it makes it one of the characteristic temples, it was established by the architect Senimut for the Queen Hatshepsut, the Temple was called before “Northern monastery”, it is well known now as El-Deir El-Bahary, your last stop at the west Bank will be to colossi of Memnon, at the end of your tour Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Luxor train station for departure back to Cairo by night Sleeper train, then have dinner. Overnight on Sleeper Train

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Cairo
itinerary.description: Once you arrive Giza train station, you will be escorted by Ibis Egypt tours representative to your hotel, manage to relax, or try optional excursion to Alexandria city where you can taste different culture at Cata Comb of Kom El-Shokafa, Qaitbai Citadel, and Alexandria Library, walk through the magnificent Montazah Palace, or amuse your eyes by visiting Roman amphitheatre ( If visit was allowed ), other different optional at night are available between Dinner Cruise on the magic Nile River where you can enjoy watching real Belly Dancer and Folklore show. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: St Catherine Monastery Tour
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast is waiting for you at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle to unforgettable trip to St. catherine, passing by Moses Eyes, continue driving till arrive to the seven daughters Monastery, have a short visit to the seven Daughters Monastery, continue driving till arrive to St. Catherine, check into your hotel, manage to relax at hotel, enjoy the relish of your dinner at hotel. Overnight in St. Catherine

itinerary.title: Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.description: Wake up call at 01:30 am., A cup of tea will be offered to each person for free, around 02:00 am., it is your chance to escape the crowds, Unleash your inner by climbing Moses mountain, enjoy the sun rising over Sinai Mountains, then come down for a magical visit to St. Catherine Monastery, passing by Room of the Skulls, the last point will be to the famous burning bush, at the end of your tour transfer back to your hotel, enjoy your breakfast, finally drive by air-conditioned vehicle to Sharm El-Sheikh, check into your hotel. Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast is waiting for you at your hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Sharm El-Sheikh, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or snorkeling to watch the ravishing Coral reefs, optional to try Desert Safari at the heart of Sinai Desert from sharm. Overnight in Sharm El-Sheikh

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast box is waiting for you at hotel, at 04:30 am., drive by air-conditioned vehicle to Taba marina to start you unforgettable tour, take your Ferry boat at 06:30 am. To Aqaba, once you arrive Aqaba Port Ibis Egypt tours representative will help you to get your visa, then he will escort you to Wadi Rum by air-conditioned vehicle, it takes approx. 40 minutes to arrive to Wadi Rum, enjoy the landscape of Wadi rum desert, the British liaison officer Lawrence of Arabia who was fascinated by Wadi Rum, he was describing Wadi Rum as "vast, echoing and god-like", for sure he could not have said it better, Start to scout Wadi Rum by four-wheel-drive Jeep, amuse your eyes by watching the Lawrence’s spring, continue driving to the majestic mountains, watch a gorge with its drawings for ancient rock, Have some time for free, you will find Horses and Camels available upon request inside the desert, finally Ibis Egypt tours representative will drive you to Petra, check into your hotel. Overnight in Petra

itinerary.title: Petra Tour
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast is waiting for you at your hotel, unleash your inner with ravishing Tour to Petra, it was founded by Nabataean Arabs during the 6th C. BC, Petra now a days considered as one of the seven wonders of the world, it was the trading center at the Ptolemaic era in Egypt for the caravans, you will get amazing experience while entering the hidden city through a long narrow Siq, touch the natural charm while watching the beautiful handmade carved buildings, Scout the area with your tour guide who will help you and be ready for any question you might ask, enjoy Horse riding till the entrance of the canyon, Riding a camel available as well upon request inside the city, Lunch will be served at local restaurant in Petra, at the end of your tour Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you back to Aqaba port, take the ferry boat to Taba Marina, once you arrive Taba Marina meet and assist, transfer to hotel, and have dinner. Overnight in Taba

itinerary.title: Back to Cairo
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast is waiting for you at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle back to Cairo, once you arrive Cairo, check into your hotel manage to relax. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Tasty breakfast is waiting for you at your hotel, today we will say good bye to Egypt, it is your final departure day, after breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International Airport for final departure.
